Gable Roof over Rectangular Footprint

Build a gable roof shell (no initial file) over a rectangular eave of dimensions 6 x 4 m (long axis along X). The ridge runs parallel to the long (X) axis, centered over the rectangle (Y = 2 m). Eave height Z = 2.0 m. Ridge height Z = 3.0 m.

The roof consists of 4 surfaces:
- 2 sloped rectangular roof planes (at +/-Y)
- 2 vertical triangular gable ends (at X = 0 and X = 6)

Save the native SketchUp model to `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\answer.skp`.

Requirements:
1. `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\answer.skp` can be opened and inspected as a native SketchUp model.
2. Bounding box 6 x 4 x 1 m (within 10 mm) - roof occupies the space from eave (Z=2) to peak (Z=3).
3. Z min = 2.0, Z max = 3.0 within 2 mm.
4. Exactly one ridge line (vertices with Z approx 3.0) forms a line of length >= 6 m along X at Y = 2.
5. Vertex count matches an axially-triangulated roof: >= 6 and <= 20 (a clean gable has 6 unique corner vertices).
source: AGS — roof geometry; SU-Help Intersect Faces
